senses.gloss:
दौहित्र दौहित्र, i. e. दुहितृ + अ,
 I. m. A daughter's son, Man. 3, 148.
 II. f. त्री, A daughter's daughter, Rām. 6, 95, 36.
 III. m. A rhinoceros, Mārk. P. 32, 7.
दौहित्रक दौहित्र + क, adj. Referring to a daughter's son, MBh. 13, 2476.
दौहित्रवन्त् दौहित्र + वन्त्, adj. Having a daughter's son, MBh. 5, 3930.

दौहृद दौहृद (a dialectical form of दौर्हृद, q. cf.), n.
 1. The longing of pregnant women, Suśr. 1, 89, 12.
 2. Pregnancy, Suśr. 1, 322, 15.
दौहृदिनी दौहृदिनी, i. e. दौहृद + इन् + ई, adj. f. Pregnant, Suśr. 1, 322, 12.
